name: Heaven's Binds
source:
Waking up on a desolate shore after the ship of her captors crash, Rana yearns to return home, to her village and family. But a mysterious force is weaving the threads of her destiny, preventing her return. 
Rana must unravel her bindings and confront the ones pulling the strings of her fate.

[From [url=https://morrowshore.itch.io/binds]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
绑架者的船失事后，拉娜在荒凉的海岸上醒来，她渴望回到家乡，回到她的村庄和家人身边。但一股神秘的力量正在编织她的命运之线，阻止她回归。
拉娜必须解开她的束缚，面对那些操纵她命运的人。

[来自[url=https://morrowshore.itch.io/binds]itch.io[/url]]
